The names-lead switch stood in the row as a pill for a day (the owner, that morning: "no names and no blanks, if i flip them on or off it should just change those select cells"); it is off the row now and stays on the rail (?rail=all) and on /toggles/. Where a word's line is its name (proper-name-rule-v1), the reading the name displaced is baked beside it (gloss_orders.noname, tools/regloss-zone.mjs); the switch lays it over those lines and no other. P1  nothing on the book page offers it: no pill in the row, no entry in the bottom Menu; the rail's row stands under ?rail=all at "the name leads" on a fresh visit P2  pressed to "no names" on the rail, the lines that change are exactly the lines of the words whose key the name led and whose displaced reading is baked: each reads the reading the name displaced at its place, and no other line moves. Under "only this pointing" (the default since 2026-11-06, the pointing stands) that reading is the pointing's own leader at the place (the lattice sidecar's grade, o.l, or its alternate o.la with the leader's carriers switched off); the baked column answers where the form carries no grade, and under every other setting. A line whose displaced reading reads as its name does moves by its credit alone, so the credit is compared too. P3  the card of such a word opens pressed on what the line now says, the name is still among its pills, and the card no longer says the name leads P4  pressed back to "the name leads", every line is the line of the first paint, byte for byte P5  the choice is kept on the device: a reload opens with the lines moved; reset puts them back and says "default" P6  /toggles/ lists the switch among the rail's, drawn only with the switches, never on every book page The page is the first served zone that carries the column, found on disk; no book is named here (check-scope-derived S1). SAME PRODUCT (the rebuild, 2026-10-23: "a full rebuild, same product, lighter weight"). Two builds of the site, the one shipped and the one proposed, served at two origins, print the same thing to a reader: S1  on every sampled chapter page, read whole (every section of the chapter built and read, not only the stretch the arrival builds; a section of it one build did not build is said), every word's line and its chip are the same, under the default switches, with no blanks on, with no names on, in the English reader, and under each default source other than STEP pressed and then STEP pressed to come back (default-picks-rule-v1; a switch one build lacks is reported, not compared). A word's line is the line drawn over it: its own, or, where it stands in words one card joins, the run's part under it (none where the run draws it bare) or the run's one line over all of them (the lines resting-lines-v1 reads). With --expect data/default-picks/index.json, the lines the new build fills at rest (where STEP leaves a word and its second, the source that fills most of what STEP leaves in the book, reads it) are the differences the batch makes on purpose: every line that differs is one of them, and every one of them on a sampled page reads the second's words under the second's chip; so are the lines where the old build's line is bare and the index carries STEP's own words (step_words): there the new line is STEP's words drawn as the page draws them (a "/" a joint; under the signs switch at rest a piece that is a sign alone, beside pieces that carry words, drawn as the hidden sign's gap), under STEP's chip (M4), under every switch both builds carry; and so are the lines of their neighbors in the run: a word whose part was a sign alone, standing because no part of the run carried words, is drawn as the hidden sign's gap under its own chip once STEP's words stand beside it; and under each default source pressed, a word of a reading the place gives across words (a reading ending with a hyphen goes on in the next word: TAHOT's «from/ Beth-» «-lehem», «Tubal-» «Cain») that no one source reads at every word of it keeps the line as it rests, the new build's own line at rest there, where an older build printed a source's line at one word of it and the other's half alone (zone.html dfltHalvesOf, the review of the toggles fixes, 15 November 2026); and so does a word of one unit a source reads at every word of it from one pick (one entry across words, or one such reading) whose words stand apart on the page, in no one cell, where an older build printed the unit under each word (zone.html dfltApartUnit, the review of the second fix round, 15 November 2026: BDB's «in Babylonia» at both words of Tel-melah, Nehemiah 7:61:3-4). The owed lines are read from the index, the zones, the default picks' book files and the page, never named; a line not drawn as owed is said once S2  the cards of the first words of the chapter carry the same pills in the same order with the same one pressed THE DICTIONARIES THAT REST SHUT (dictionary-kinds-rule-v1, 15 November 2026). With --expect data/dictionary-kinds-v1.json, on a book the record rests shut (its scope, asked of the new build's zone), the differences the record makes on purpose are owed: on S1, a line that differs is one whose old chip names a source the record rests shut whole (a word's line or a run's), or whose old leader at its place (the old sidecar's o.l, or its place's own e[…].l, under «only»; the old zone's table line where the word is not graded or its name leads; never an alternate, la or alt, which the line reads only under the reader's switches) held one among its own carriers and the new build at rest leads the word otherwise, a reading that lost the rank a shut co-carrier's year gave it, or named a source that carries the credited reading only in rows a category of its own data rests shut (English Wiktionary's names: «Zilpah.», «Gershom.»), asked of the new build's store whole and at rest; its new chip names no such source; and every old line whose chip named one differs. On S2, a card that differs lost only pills whose every old carrier is a source shut whole or of a family a fact entry rests shut in part (English Wiktionary's names), and says it holds back at least as many (data-kind-withheld); it carries no pill the old card lacks, the pills both carry keep their order (each compared by its printed form, case folded, as the card groups them), and its pressed pill moves only where its word's line moved as owed. A work the record does not rest shut is compared as before, line for line and pill for pill. --expect may be given twice, and each file is told by its own rule_id; a file of another rule is refused, never guessed. THE WORDS STAND ALONE AT REST (words-stand-alone-rule-v1, ship 10 of 20 November 2026). Owed with no file named: the rule is the page's own, so it is read from the two pages, and holds only where the new build's zone.html declares the rule and the old build's does not. On S2, the first card of a word that stood in a joined cell on the old build (a chain's, or a place's the new build sets aside) is the word's own card: the joined cell's card asked its words with no pointing and no entry, so the word's own card, which passes its gates, may lose pills. It stands at the word's own place, it gains no pill, and the same reading stays pressed; the order of a pool its gates filtered is its own and is not asked. On S1 nothing is owed by this rule itself: a line under a source pressed, at a word of one unit that source reads at every word of it, reads as it rests once the words stand apart, which the default picks' expectation already holds (unitsIn). SHIP 5'S LANDINGS (the design of ships 5 and 6, section 8; the lead's calls of 15 November 2026). Each is owed only where its expectation is given, and a moved line or card no class explains is a difference as before: (a) call 4's stands (steps-reading-stands-rule-v1; with the default picks' index, its step_words whose third element is 1): under the STEP layer (every switch but a source pressed), the line is STEP's words drawn as the page draws them under STEP's chip, whatever the old line was; under MACULA, UBS or BDB pressed, only where the pressed source has no line at the place and its second is STEP (the page's defaultAtWord; a pair keeps today's line there); under «no names» a name that yields to the table's noname column is not the layer's. Said «stands:». On S2 the word's card may gain STEP's reading and open on it, its line having moved so (b) call 7's Strong's sign (zone-gloss-rule-v8; with the audit-calls pin, data/audit-calls/PIN.json, whose call-7 landing names the rule), on a book whose new zone was baked with the sign last (its emitted_from.signs_rest_last): a piece of the old line that opens with Strong's sign (gloss-store's opensWithStrongSign, the bracketed sign of the lead's call 1 too), where the same piece of the new line does not and a row under the word's keys in the new store prints it, every other piece the same. Said «strongs sign:». On S2 the card of such a word may lose the old line's signed reading, the pill it opened on, and opens on the new line's (c) call 3's runs (run-reads-its-words-rule-v1; with the audit-calls pin and relay v181's list it pins, held to its sha256): a word drawn under the run's one line over the very words a line of v181 covers, where every word of it has its own reading at the place (its place's pieces all say something, or call 4's stands), now reads its own: at rest its place's pieces as the page draws them, under a chip; under any other switch anything but a run's one line. Said «runs:». On S2 the first card of such a word differs as it will, opened on the word itself (the page's window.__cardPlace is the word's place, or, a card of the run's cell, the word's own block is the one pressed) (d) the dictionaries that rest shut (with the kinds record): a lost pill's carrier of a family a fact entry rests shut in part excuses it only where each row of it that prints the reading rests shut at the card's own place (UBS's collocation rows stand at the places UBS's own pick names them, ubs-collocations-rule-v1), so such a place still owes the pill; S1's «a reading on rows a category rests shut» asks the word's place the same way (e) question 12's one pill (pointer-one-pill-rule-v1; with the form-of record under form-of-pills-rule-v3, which carries one_pill): on S2 a card may lose a plain pill whose English a pill of the new card prints with a pointer beside it (data-pointer) and names the pointer's rows (data-pointer-by); that pill stands where the plain one stood, the pointer's own pill of the old card joining it The sample: every fifth served book with a chapter page, the first and the last among them, chapter 1 and the middle chapter of each; no book is named here (check-scope-derived S1). Without two origins the check skips. Every number the page prints is counted again here, in node, from the files the page is served (the dictionary store, the route store, the index's he/ shards, the books' order), never by asking the page's own functions. S1  the field stands above the toggles row, empty, with no results shown S2  a page word's letters, typed: "these letters" is that word, with the store's count of its places; "starting with these letters · N" is every other word that begins so (a final letter matching its medial form), N as the he/ shards count it and at least two, and the hits shown are the first twelve of them, by places, then letters S3  two readings a word's card draws, typed in English: one a per-place source reads ("read so at N places", N counted again, with who reads it) and one only a dictionary gives ("a dictionary reads it so"); each label's "N Hebrew words" counted from the route store, pieced as the card pieces it, and the dictionary store S4  with the card shut for real, a hit opens that word's card as the concordance at its first place in this book, and the page stays S5  a reading no source gives says so, and clearing the field clears it S6  a word typed in a pointing other than its first place's is found by its consonants, says "N pointed so" (fewer than all its places), and opens at the first place in this book pointed so, not at the letters' first place (the owner, 2026-10-18: "always find despite voweling, go off consonants only with voweling as best match preferencing") S7  letters that stand only in other books open at the first of their places in the books' order: the address is that book's page with dict=on and the place, and the card there is the concordance S8  the same from a page opened with ?dict=off: the address still says dict=on, and the card is the concordance S9  a pointing typed among the words that start with its letters: the words that stand so, or begin so, come first, each saying how many places stand in the pointing it shows S10 a word typed with its final letter also lists the longer words that go on with the medial form; typed with a medial last letter it finds the word written with the final S11 a query that starts with a final letter is read as its letter (one consonant, one letter): it answers as the medial form does, never "did not answer" S12 the fold's odd inputs: a curly and a straight apostrophe, a reading in angle brackets and its words bare, answer alike, and as many words as the fold written here counts S13 a ketiv/qere pasted from the page, "(ketiv) [qere]", is read by its qere: the qere's word, with how many places stand pointed so S14 the ketiv's letters find the ketiv/qere place, and the hit opens there S15 Escape while a search is on its way clears the box, and the late answer never paints S16 a hit chosen with the keyboard leaves focus inside the card S17 with TAHOT switched off on the rail, a reading TAHOT gives no longer answers for the word it alone reads so, or its count drops S18 the index names the record of what each dictionary is (dictionary-kinds-rule-v1) it was baked under, by the sha256 of the record as served, and leaves out exactly the rows a category of their own source rests shut (an entry that names a fact: what English Wiktionary files as a name), counted again here THE DICTIONARIES THAT REST SHUT, in every count here as on the page: a row a category of its source rests shut is in the index nowhere, open or shut, and the model leaves it out as the bake does; a source the record rests shut whole stays in the index, and the page leaves it out while it rests shut, as it leaves out a source the reader switched off, on any page, since every place the index answers is of a book the record rests shut; so the model does too (its ids from the record and the store's index as served; whether they stand shut and the record held, from the page's own state). THE WORDS THAT OPEN A NUMBERED SENSE (sense-openings-rule-v1) are a note on the card and no pill: the index takes none of them, and the model leaves them out too (opensSense, below). The words are found on the page or in the data, never named here (check-scope-derived S1). Usage: node tools/check-search-v1.mjs [url]
